sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that marriage of the applicant No.1 was solemnized with the opposite party No.2 on 29.11.2008 and due to some matrimonial dispute, opposite party No.2 moved an application under Section 156(3)
Cr.P.C. and requested for lodging of F.I.R. and the order was passed for lodging the F.I.R. Thereafter, F.I.R. as Case Crime No.180 of 2013, under Sections 498-A, 323,
506 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Bagwala, District Etah was lodged on 09.11.2013 and all the family members were dragged in the prosecution merely on the basis of concocted facts.
He further submitted that charge sheet was filed by the Investigating Officer against the applicant No.1, who was the husband of the opposite party No.2, and the trial was going on.

At the same time, on the basis of concocted facts, F.I.R. No.110 of 2019, under Sections 498-A, 323, 354, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S.
Bagwala, District Eta was lodged by the opposite party No.2 on 05.06.2019 with the identical allegations that on 21.05.2019, applicant No.1, who was having illicit relations with her sister-in-law (Jethani), and when she raised objection then she was scolded by them, and they also tried to outrage her modesty.

Learned counsel for the applicants has further submitted that during the course of investigation, Investigating Officer has failed to consider this fact that earlier, one F.I.R. was lodged by the prosecutrix for victimization in relation to demand of dowry and she has also not disclosed that when the opposite party No.2 started living with her in-laws, as impugned proceeding is sheer abuse of legal process.
Therefore, the matter requires consideration.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the applicants and submitted that after detailed investigation, charge sheet was filed and there is no illegality in the impugned charge sheet as well as summoning order.
Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and going through the records, it is evident that in the year of 2013, one F.I.R.
was lodged by the opposite party No.2, but she has not disclosed that since when she started living with the applicant.
Therefore, the matter requires consideration.
Issue notice to the opposite party No.2.
Steps be taken within two weeks.
List this case in the month of February, 2022.
Till the next date of listing, impugned proceedings shall remain stayed.

"
